title: Calibration Low-Use Allowance (Calibration Workmanship Warranty Goodwill)
content:
**Allowance.** Under the Workmanship Warranties, a calibration low-use allowance is added into the calibration goodwill sum on a Calibration Workmanship Warranty. The calibration low-use allowance follows the miles driven from the odometer at issue to the odometer recorded at the most recent calibration-fault report, together with the whole calendar months from the issued date to the goodwill date:

- at most the first low-use mileage of 14000 miles and fewer than the low-use months of 12: the full low-use allowance, USD 6.00;
- more than 14000 but at most the second low-use mileage of 16000 miles, and fewer than 12 months: the half low-use allowance, USD 3.00;
- any other combination: no calibration low-use allowance.

## Truth table

| Miles driven since issue | Whole calendar months from issued date to goodwill date | Allowance |
|---|---|---|
| 14000 or fewer | fewer than 12 | USD 6.00 |
| 14000 or fewer | 12 or more | none |
| more than 14000, at most 16000 | fewer than 12 | USD 3.00 |
| more than 14000, at most 16000 | 12 or more | none |
| more than 16000 | any | none |

## Inputs

- **Odometer at issue:** recorded on the coverage at issue.
- **Odometer at report:** the odometer recorded on the most recent calibration-fault concern report on the coverage.
- **Months in service:** whole calendar months from the coverage's issued date to the date the goodwill is figured.

## Boundary cases (hypothetical, 7 whole months in service)

| Miles driven | Allowance |
|---|---|
| 14000 | USD 6.00 |
| 14001 | USD 3.00 |
| 16000 | USD 3.00 |
| 16001 | none |

With 12 whole months in service instead, every row gives no allowance.
